title: Rename company branding to ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS and enlarge header

requirements.summary: Replace all user-facing occurrences of "Legend Techno Solutions" with "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" across marketing UI and shared metadata (header, footer, logo lightbox, document title/meta).
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays the company name exactly as "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" (no remaining "Legend Techno Solutions" text in the header).
Footer branding/copyright uses "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" (no remaining "Legend Techno Solutions" text in the footer).
Logo-related accessible text (e.g., aria-label/alt) uses "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" (no remaining "Legend Techno Solutions" accessible strings in these components).
`frontend/index.html` `<title>` (and any meta description text that includes the company name) is updated to reference "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS".

file_operations.description: Update the HTML document title (and any meta description text if it includes the company name) to reference "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" instead of "Legend Techno Solutions".
Update header branding strings and accessibility text (aria-label, image alt, visible brand text) to use "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS".
Update footer branding strings (logo button aria-label, logo alt text, brand text, and copyright line) to use "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS".
Update logo lightbox accessible text (dialog aria-label and logo image alt) to use "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS".
Update any fallback/static marketing copy that still references "Legend Techno Solutions" (e.g., default about heading/description) to "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS".

requirements.summary: Increase the header’s overall size while preserving responsive layout and usable navigation/mobile menu.
acceptanceCriteria: The header height is increased compared to the current implementation (e.g., larger container height and/or increased logo/text sizing) and remains visually consistent in dark theme.
On desktop widths, the navigation links remain on a single line and are not clipped.
On mobile widths, the menu button remains visible and functional, and the header does not overlap page content.

file_operations.description: Increase header container height and adjust logo/branding sizing (and spacing) to make the header visibly larger while keeping desktop nav on one line and maintaining functional mobile menu behavior.

requirements.summary: Ensure "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" is prominently visible in the header branding area across breakpoints, including small screens, without breaking logo lightbox behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile and desktop, the header displays the text "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" in the branding area without requiring opening the menu.
If space is constrained on very small screens, the company name may wrap, truncate, or reduce font size, but it must remain visible and readable (not fully hidden).
The logo click/tap behavior (opening the logo lightbox) continues to work as before.

file_operations.description: Adjust responsive header branding so the company name "ALGLOE TECHNO SOLUTIONS" remains visible on mobile (remove full hide-on-mobile behavior; allow wrap/truncate/size reduction as needed) while preserving the logo lightbox trigger behavior.
